fields.why: Urbanization appears only as a sampling-frame stratum for PSU selection; no results are reported or adjusted by rurality, so it is a design step rather than a covariate. Rule needed: variables used only to form sampling strata are not equity dimensions unless estimates are reported or adjusted by them.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether sampling-design strata (urbanization, minority density) count as covariate/weighting roles for an SPD; level is unaffected here.
